changes.comment: split node 'status-change' from per-peer 'peer-status-change' events with a dedicated MeshPeerStatus union, removed the unused MeshNode.id, meshQrCodec.encode now falls back to plain codec output instead of throwing MeshUnsupportedError, host no longer emits misattributed ice-state events for pending invitations, empty answer peer ids rejected, concurrent same-peer-id answers race-guarded, and the in-memory WebRTC fake is now published as the @vielzeug/mesh/testing subpath
